'''Hedron δ''' is a [[Common enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|The "Diaphaistagran Dinedon" (archive ID: ARM315δ) is an energized variant of ARM315. When irradiated by sunlight, it gives off a shimmering purple light. However, it assumes a different form when irradiated by light reflecting off Talos.}}

==Overview==
A unique variant of [[Hedron]], Hedrons δ have similar appearance with their counterpart, but it doesn't make them more of the threat; Aside from a shot, which deals Cryo damage and {{G|Cryo Infliction}} in an area, they can dash to Operators, which deals Cryo damage.
